description: Project 2027 is my plan to defend democracy, protect our rights, and make government work for the people again. At a time when powerful interests are pushing to weaken our institutions and concentrate power, Project 2027 offers a clear alternative: accountability, fairness, and opportunity for every community. It protects voting rights, reproductive freedom, public education, and the rule of law, while investing in working families and a strong future. This is about standing up for our values and delivering real results.

title: Trump’s Project 2025 vs. Ford’s Project 2027 - Ford for Congress
